item.title: Hamilton Woman Booked On Probation Violation Warrant
item.description: A Hamilton woman was booked into the Caldwell County Detention Center on a probation violation warrant. Her hearing is set for March 6th. Twenty-two-year-old Rianna F. Eckenrod is held with bond set at $20,000 cash only. Eckenrod was placed on five years of probation in November of 2024, on a property damage conviction.

item.title: Venezuelan Arrested By Troopers
item.description: A Venezuelan resident was arrested by State Troopers in Linn County on Monday. Twenty-seven-year-old Yorman J. Sepulveda was arrested at about 1:41 pm for alleged no valid license. He was taken to the Macon County Jail.

item.title: No Trash Pick-Up On Monday
item.description: Chillicothe Municipal Utilities will be closed on Monday for the President’s Day holiday. Because of the holiday, Chillicothe residents with a Monday Trash Route will need to wait to put out their trash until Tuesday. Monday’s Trash Routes in Chillicothe will be picked up on Tuesday, along with the regular Tuesday routes.
